title: AI Science Tracker
description: Versioned repository snapshot containing the catalog of AI-enabled scientific discoveries, the separate AI-found vulnerability catalog, attributed model and benchmark data, and website code. Scientific records cite original papers, preprints or institutional announcements. The archive is publicly downloadable. Reuse terms apply by component. The original catalog content and attributed Epoch data use CC BY 4.0, OpenAlex citation metadata uses CC0, the separately attributed SWE-bench Verified data uses CC BY-NC 4.0, and CharXiv data uses CC BY-SA 4.0. Other benchmarks retain their original terms, website code uses MIT, and fonts retain their license notices. The bundled api/v1/manifest.json identifies the exact snapshot and lists each data component's terms. See the Dataset page for scope and reuse guidance.
notes: Cite this version DOI when referring to the archived snapshot. Cite the original sources for scientific claims.
